channel.description: This is a randomly ordered feed of the most recent entries from SSbreakingHeadlines, skipping any feeds with errors.

item.title: Southern California Edison equipment blamed for 2025 Eaton Fire in Los Angeles
item.description: Los Angeles fire officials say the deadly 2025 Eaton fire was caused by Southern California Edison equipment.

item.title: Rubio reports progress in Strait of Hormuz talks
item.description: Secretary of State Marco Rubio said talks between Iran and Oman have advanced, though no final deal is in place. He expressed hope for a resolution.

item.title: Victims identified in Idaho In-N-Out shooting
item.description: Families have identified two of the three people killed in Saturday's shooting at an Idaho In-N-Out Burger restaurant.

item.title: Michigan primary highlights Democratic divide
item.description: Rep. Debbie Dingell discusses the state's competitive primaries and their implications for the Democratic Party's direction.
